Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 temp_buffer := :s_contract_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 SELECT company 
 INTO :s_company 
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = temp_buffer AND 
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 -- chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id AND 
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND --MLT 246 Code changes - As user able to select contract id linked with chapter id
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1); --- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10)
 ;
 NEXT_ITEM;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT contract_id
 ,company 
 INTO :s_contract_id
 ,:s_company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE UPPER(company) LIKE ('%'||temp_buffer || '%') AND 
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1) -- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10) AND 
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 -- chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' --MLT 246 Code changes - As user able to select contract id linked with chapter id
 ;
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := NULL;
 LIST_VALUES;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('5150');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :s_contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_company := NULL;
 LIST_VALUES;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select b.min_temp, b.max_temp
 into temp_min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'RG' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 exists (select 'x'
 from units
 where contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id -- IM 6958
 and batch_id = b.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and (nvl(red_tube_flag,'N') !='Y'
 or nvl(red_tube_2_flag,'N') !='Y' -- MLT 451
 or nvl(purple_tube_flag,'N')!='Y'
 or nvl(serum_plasma_ind,'N') !='Y'
 or nvl(red_tube_2_flag,'N') != 'Y'));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*),
 count(decode(nvl(red_tube_flag,'N'), 'Y',
 decode(nvl(red_tube_2_flag,'N'), 'Y', -- MLT 451
 decode(nvl(purple_tube_flag,'N'), 'Y',
 decode(nvl(serum_plasma_ind,'N'), 'Y',null,1),1),1),1))
 into :s_unit_count, :s_count_no_trns
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 if :s_unit_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BATCH_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT b.batch_id,
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, received_date),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
FROM batch_inputs b
WHERE b.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
AND batch_id IN
 (SELECT batch_id
 FROM units
 WHERE contract_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 /* modified by hcl consulting */
 AND (NVL(red_tube_flag,'N') !='Y'
 OR NVL(purple_tube_flag,'N') !='Y'
 OR NVL(serum_plasma_ind,'N') !='Y'
 OR NVL(red_tube_2_flag,'N') !='Y')
 )
AND SUBSTR(batch_id,8,2)='RG'
ORDER BY insert_dats DESC
